_note: StoreHub is an all-in-one platform for F&B and retail businesses in Southeast Asia

company.description: StoreHub is an all-in-one, cloud-based business platform that enables retailers and restaurants across Southeast Asia to automate and grow their businesses. Launched in 2013, it provides an ecosystem of solutions including POS, QR ordering, loyalty, customer engagement, delivery, and marketplace integration.
company.mission: Make technology available for everyone — big or small — enabling all businesses to grow successfully and sustainably.
company.tagline: More Than Just a POS System
company.merchant_count_display: 20,000+ retail and restaurant outlets across Southeast Asia

products.name: StoreHub POS
products.short_description: All-in-one POS system for restaurants and retail stores
products.long_description: StoreHub POS is the core product — a tablet-based point-of-sale system that manages orders, payments, and inventory. Designed for F&B and retail businesses with no training required.
usps: Manage all online & offline transactions in one system
Top-of-the-line POS hardware with seamless payment integration
Zero learning curve — no training required user interface
Works for both dine-in, takeaway, and delivery
Real-time sales reports and analytics
pain_points_solved: Managing orders across multiple channels is chaotic
Staff training takes too long and turnover is high
Losing track of inventory and stock levels
Can't see business performance in real time

products.name: Beep QR Ordering
products.short_description: QR code ordering system — customers order directly from their phones
products.long_description: Beep lets customers scan a QR code to browse the menu and place orders directly on their phones. Reduces staff workload and speeds up table turnover.
usps: No app download required for customers
Reduces order errors from verbal communication
Frees up staff for higher-value tasks
Integrates directly with StoreHub POS
pain_points_solved: Staff overwhelmed during peak hours taking orders
High error rate with verbal/written orders

products.name: StoreHub Engage
products.short_description: Automated customer engagement via WhatsApp/SMS — loyalty, win-backs, promotions
products.long_description: StoreHub Engage automates customer communication. Send targeted promotions, loyalty rewards, and win-back messages to lapsed customers via WhatsApp or SMS — all automated from customer purchase data.
usps: Automated win-back messages to lapsed customers
Loyalty program built in — no separate app needed
Targeted promotions based on purchase history
Drives repeat visits without manual effort
pain_points_solved: Losing customers who don't come back after first visit
No way to communicate with customers between visits
Manual loyalty stamp cards are hard to manage

products.name: CashBack (via Engage)
products.short_description: Cashback loyalty program that keeps customers coming back
products.long_description: A cashback reward system that automatically credits customers after each purchase, incentivizing return visits. Merchants set the cashback percentage.
usps: Higher customer retention vs traditional punch cards
Customers motivated to return to 'use their cashback'
Zero admin for merchants — fully automated
pain_points_solved: High customer churn — hard to build loyalty
Punch card loyalty programs are easy to fake/lose

products.name: QR Order (Online Ordering / Delivery)
products.short_description: Own online ordering channel — no commission to Grab/FoodPanda
products.long_description: StoreHub's own online ordering system lets merchants take direct delivery and takeaway orders without paying 30%+ commissions to third-party platforms.
usps: Keep 100% of your revenue — no platform commissions
Direct customer relationships (you own the data)
Integrates with your existing StoreHub POS
Customers order via your own branded page
pain_points_solved: Paying 30%+ commission to GrabFood/FoodPanda eating into margins
Third-party platforms own your customer relationships
No insight into delivery customer behavior
